desc:
Water Park World is a tycoon game in which you build and manage your own water park (or waterpark)! Choose from hundreds of items, build and ride the craziest slides and work in your park, and hire staff to help manage your park! You can co-operate with friends to build a park together too!

Beta system requirements:
- Windows/Mac device --- you must use a keyboard and mouse (touch/controller input not yet supported)
- At least 4 GB of RAM
- Screen resolution of at least 1300 × 700 strongly recommended

Currently the plan is to make the game free to play once the beta is over.
